Interface AuthProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
BearerAuth, BootstrapAdminAuth, OIDCAuth, PasswordTotpAuth
public interface AuthProvider
Pluggable auth provider for the W2 SDK.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.auth_providers.AuthProvider. Both clients accept the same four concrete providers (PasswordTotpAuth, BearerAuth, BootstrapAdminAuth, OIDCAuth stub), and WorkbenchClient.connect(String, AuthProvider) mirrors ttio.workbench.connect.

Each provider exposes the username it should attribute uploads to plus an authenticate(String, int, String) method that returns a Session. The SDK caches the session on the client; re-login is the caller's choice (no automatic refresh in v1.0).

    • authenticate

      Session authenticate(String host, int port, String scheme)
      Resolve to an authenticated Session. Called once by WorkbenchClient.connect(). Implementations raise WorkbenchAuthException on failure.

    • username

      String username()
      Username the SDK will attribute uploads to (the WS handshake owner field). Surfaced ahead of the WS open so the SDK can validate without a daemon round-trip.
